actions.desc: The kapi makes two attacks: one with its quarterstaff and one with its tail trip.
actions.desc_ru: Мультиатака. Существо совершает 2 атаки: одну — атака «Боевой посох»; одну — атака «Хвост Трип».
actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Quarterstaff

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием дальнего боя: +6 к попаданию, дистанция 30/120 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 6 (1к4+4) дробящего урона.
actions.name: Sling

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.desc: The kapi can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Нимбле Феет». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Nimble Feet

traits.desc: The kapi can use its tail to pick up or hold a small object that isn't being worn or carried. It can use its tail to interact with objects, leaving its hands free to wield weapons or carry heavier objects. The kapi can't use its tail to wield a weapon but can use it to trip an opponent (see below).
